prompt: High aerial at night over a vast stacked British motorway interchange of curving concrete flyovers: every deck is a camp, hundreds of small fires and lanterns tracing the curves of the flyovers like a map of the roads, the town beyond completely dark except for one cluster of brightly lit office towers on the skyline. Winter night in a near-future Britain, the streetlights dead, lit only by braziers, camping lanterns and the glow of the city's towers; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
